name: taskade
description: Use Taskade from your AI tool: import a spreadsheet into a project, fix a Taskade Genesis app, report on your projects and automations, back up an app, and plan a new app for Taskade EVE to build. Connects to the hosted Taskade MCP server with your Taskade login. Needs a paid Taskade plan.

interface.longDescription: Import a spreadsheet into a Taskade project, fix a Genesis app with a checked change, get a status report from your projects and automations, back up an app, or plan a new app. Sign in with your Taskade account. The plugin cannot create or edit an automation or publish an app. Taskade EVE does those jobs inside Taskade.
